questions.question: Define accounting and describe its objectives. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Accounting is an art of recording, classifying and summarizing in a significant manner and in
  • terms of money transactions and events which are in part atleast of a financial character and
  • interpreting the result thereof.
  • Objectives: a) To keep systematic records b) To ascertain the net result of business
  • operations c) To ascertain the financial position of the business concern and d) To provide
  • accounting information to interested parties.

  • Bills payable etc. )
  • Capital : Amount invested by the owner.

questions.question: Describe the systems of accounting. / [CO3] [4x5 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Systems of accounting:
  • Cash system : It records revenues and expenses only when cash is actually received or paid.
  • Accrual system: : It records transactions when they occur, not when the cash related to
  • them is actually received or paid.
